snippet.title: MARKET GARDEN - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
🔥 MARKET GARDEN launches on Steam – August 1st, 2025! ❗
Wishlist now and get ready for battle!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3471890/MARKET_GARDEN/

🔥Relive the golden era of WW2 games in MARKET GARDEN -  game that pays tribute both to the genre’s finest moments and the real historical events.
